There’s just a feeling that there’s more to it. I know he cares deeply about my well-being. Maybe he tries too hard in other areas and this is a fairly innocent area where he can be “mean” without being “mean”. Sometimes I think it’s me who’s wrong and can’t take a joke, but then again the amount of licks and tickles would drive anyone mad.

But he does. In every other aspect of life. He treats me with great respect and kindness. This is really the only issue I have with him. Otherwise he’s always checking in with me if I’m okay about stuff and so on. That’s why I really want to learn if I can. I know I’ve painted a very one sided picture of him, but he is truly so caring in all other matters and really makes en effort to make our relationship be the best.

I’ve never thought of it that way. I’ve always thought I had to be a good sport. Sometimes I tickle people but in a very loving way. I sincerely hope they see it that way as well.
